name: rx-color-picker
title: Color Picker (React)
description: Colour picker on an OKLCH area and channel sliders (hue, alpha, lightness, chroma), with a text field in oklch/hex/rgb/hsl, eye dropper, swatches and saved colours. Opens in a popover or renders inline. Logic shared with Angular through @gremorie/color.
